description:
Found while measuring fz-kdt.96's blast radius (2026-08-31); the
undiagnosed half was diagnosed 2026-08-31 and SPLIT OUT as fz-kdt.104
(P1: schedule-dependent miscompile -- same-denotation unions mint
distinct keys because clause order is arrival order and variant
addressing is positional). THIS ticket keeps the DISPLAY/ORDERING half
only, which is benign renumbering:

MECHANISM (proven): compare_executable_keys (jobs/backend.rs:1026)
orders the executable inventory by activation.inputs(types) and
transport_executable_sort_key (jobs/artifact.rs:1088) orders transport
positions by activation.arrow + input.to_vec() -- RAW Ty interner ids,
assigned in interning order, which the schedule decides. In 00420 two
specializations print IDENTICAL keys and differ only by Ty id; LIFO
swaps their inventory indices (x39 <-> x40) and their correct, unchanged
construction-wrapper references appear to swap. Instrumented: for
FunctionId(74) the wrapper sort keys are Ty(453,530,556,916) under FIFO
vs Ty(450,537,554,940) under LIFO -- same types, different ids.

CONSEQUENCE: canon dumps renumber under any schedule change (entry x /
callee=x lines), so cross-SCHEDULE canon comparison is noisy even where
the artifact content is identical. Cross-VERSION comparison at the fixed
production schedule (tools/canon-gate.sh) is unaffected.

FIX DIRECTION: order executables and transport positions by a faithful
ID-FREE form of the activation (the canonical type structure -- the
canon dump's own comparator/fingerprint machinery is prior art), so two
specializations indistinguishable to a reader are stably ordered and a
re-ordered pull cannot permute the inventory. NOTE: fz-kdt.104's fix (a
canonical clause order at intern) may make same-denotation Tys unify,
which shrinks but does not eliminate this class -- distinct types still
intern in schedule order. Sequence AFTER fz-kdt.104 and re-measure; the
construction=wN half should go to zero, then the entry-x renumbering is
what remains.

BYCATCH (shared with fz-kdt.104, apportion after it lands): four lib
tests fail under the LIFO flip at base --
canon_test::backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_target_fixtures
(spec-set movement: likely fz-kdt.104), drive_test::compiler2_unused_
construction_call_binding_keeps_the_root_runnable, public_trace_test::
analysis_claims_survive_a_run_that_could_not_re_derive_them,
public_trace_test::deriving_recursion_from_call_graph_facts_extracts_
each_body_once. The remaining 1514 pass under LIFO.

LIFO recipe: Agenda::pop -> pop_back (src/compiler2/agenda.rs:36),
build, dump, revert.
title: Inventory/wrapper ordering by raw Ty ids renumbers canon under schedule flips (display half; miscompile half split to fz-kdt.104)
